feedback.headline: Work on hip sway first. Little hip movement - 0.00 shoulder-widths of lateral hip travel to impact, under the tour range 0.14-0.5. Almost every tour swing moves the hips further into the shot than this. That is less hip travel than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.

tips.text: Little hip movement - 0.00 shoulder-widths of lateral hip travel to impact, under the tour range 0.14-0.5. Almost every tour swing moves the hips further into the shot than this. That is less hip travel than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.

Head drifting forward - only 0.00 shoulder-widths of separation between head and hips by impact. The head is travelling toward the target with the hips rather than staying back (tour swings open up 0.14-0.67). That is less head-behind separation than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.

Tempo too quick - 2.4:1. Your downswing was 100 ms; at the tour ratio that wants a 272-471 ms backswing, and yours was 240. Take it back longer. You swing with a quicker tempo than at least 90% of 1399 tour swings.
Good head stability - 0.00 shoulder-widths of lateral head movement to impact (nicely centered over the ball). That is less head movement than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.
Balanced finish - the body settles within 0.00 shoulder-widths through the follow-through (held and steady). That is a steadier finish than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.
Steady hips going back - 0.00 shoulder-widths of lateral hip travel to the top (centered over the ball at the top). That is less hip slide going back than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.

notes: no down-the-line view in this bundle — face-on analysis only

measurements.detail: backswing:downswing time, from phase instants; frame rate cancels
measurements.name: tempo_ratio

measurements.detail: motion start -> top, from phase instants; real-time clips only, fps does not cancel
measurements.name: backswing_ms

measurements.detail: top -> impact, from phase instants; real-time clips only, fps does not cancel
measurements.name: downswing_ms

measurements.detail: |dx| of ear midpoint, address window -> impact window
measurements.name: head_sway_norm

measurements.detail: p90 hip-center drift through follow-through
measurements.name: finish_balance_norm

measurements.detail: |dx| of hip midpoint, address window -> impact window
measurements.name: hip_sway_norm

measurements.detail: |dx| of hip midpoint, address window -> transition window
measurements.name: hip_shift_at_top_norm

measurements.detail: signed (head - hips) dx over the impact window; + is image-right, camera-frame — carries a static camera bias, see head_hip_gain_norm
measurements.name: head_hip_offset_impact_norm

measurements.detail: change in signed (head - hips) dx, address window -> impact window, one shared shoulder-width ruler; + is image-right, camera-frame, handedness resolved when judged
measurements.name: head_hip_gain_norm

measurements.detail: mean per-frame wrist-to-wrist distance over the address window; mixes x and y, so it carries the frame's pixel aspect where the lateral metrics cancel it
measurements.name: hand_separation_norm

measurements.detail: signed (wrists - shoulders) dy over the address window, + is hands below shoulders; a y quantity over an x ruler, so it carries the frame's pixel aspect. Not handedness-relative
measurements.name: hand_height_norm

measurements.detail: signed (wrists - hips) dx over the address window; + is image-right, camera-frame, handedness resolved when judged. x over x, so the frame's pixel aspect cancels
measurements.name: hand_offset_from_hips_norm

measurements.detail: PROXY: circular-mean angle of the trail wrist-to-index-knuckle vector off image-vertical at address, + is image-right. Two points on one hand, not grip rotation about the shaft
measurements.name: trail_hand_roll_deg

measurements.detail: Mahalanobis distance of the six metrics as a combination, against 458 face-on tour swings; more unusual than 90% of them. Largest contributor: hip_sway_norm
measurements.name: tour_joint_distance

measurements.detail: distance from the tour swing shape inside the fitted subspace; more unusual than 90% of 415 tour swings
measurements.name: tour_trajectory_t2

measurements.detail: residual off the tour subspace — shape the basis cannot represent; most of it falls in top->impact. NOT calibrated: it over-flags golfers the basis never saw, so read it beside T2 rather than alone
measurements.name: tour_trajectory_q

measurements.detail: peak lateral excursion of the hip centre from its address x, over the resampled swing (address -> impact); unsigned, so handedness does not enter it
measurements.name: pivot_hip_axis_drift_norm

measurements.detail: peak lateral excursion of the shoulder centre from its address x, over the resampled swing (address -> impact); unsigned
measurements.name: pivot_shoulder_axis_drift_norm

measurements.detail: sample-to-sample roughness of the hip centre's path over the resampled swing; unsigned, 0 is a perfectly smooth path
measurements.name: pivot_hip_path_jitter_norm

measurements.detail: largest against-the-turn move of the shoulder line between consecutive samples within the backswing (address -> top); magnitude only, 0 is a monotone turn
measurements.name: pivot_shoulder_reversal_backswing_deg

measurements.detail: largest against-the-turn move of the shoulder line between consecutive samples within the downswing (top -> impact); magnitude only, 0 is a monotone turn
measurements.name: pivot_shoulder_reversal_downswing_deg

provenance.note: No second view at all. `alignment` is None, a note says so, and the face-on result stands on its own — degradation reported rather than raised (ADR-013).
